records.prompt: Create a genuinely NEW native transparent game sprite atlas with EXACTLY4 columns and4 rows, sixteen individually drawn full-body poses. Equal rectangular cells, generous fully transparent gutters, no text, borders, grid, scenery, target, second person, injury or gore. Crisp detailed colored pixel-art suited to a side-view game. Every pose faces right, head-to-feet visible, ALL physical equipment fully contained. Body dimensions and anatomy keep ONE consistent scale across the entire sheet, including crouching and recoil. Every row has FOUR meaningfully distinct evolving poses, not copies or recolored cells. Exact row order: row1 ARRIVAL four walking-to-braced poses; row2 PREPARATION four aiming/bracing poses; row3 ATTACK four weapon action poses; row4 RECOVERY four lowering/withdrawing poses. Keep both hands physically connected to wrists and weapon grips. Native art supplies the body and physical weapon. No long beams, detached projectiles or explosion sprites: the game renderer supplies time-synchronized travel and contact. Use the attached image only for Dominic 'Dom' Santiago's identity and original COG costume in Gears of War2(2008): muscular Latino adult man, short black hair and beard, scarred face, bare tattooed arms, dark bulky blue-lit COG body armor, gloves, knee armor and boots. This is a FOUR-row reinforcement atlas, not the reference animation. For this action he carries the original bulky short-barrel Gnasher shotgun, NOT the reference's long Lancer chainsaw rifle; no chainsaw on the Gnasher. Arrival with Gnasher low in both hands, then plant feet. Preparation raise stock to shoulder and settle cheek weld with correct two-handed grip. Attack controlled short Gnasher volley with visible recoil, tiny local muzzle flash at most; distinct lean/recoil/pump/reset poses. Recovery lower shotgun safely, shift weight and take two withdrawal steps. His Maria memories and Cole's slogans create no visual power. Exactly4x4 native poses, true transparency.
